notToBeConfusedWith.name: Angostura bitters
notToBeConfusedWith.note: A separate aromatic bitters, darker and more clove-forward; this one is lighter, more anise-and-cherry, and is the one named for the New Orleans apothecary who sold it.

forms.label: Standard
forms.sourceNote: The producer's own nutrition page states 70 proof (35% alc./vol.) and zero calories, carbohydrate, sugar and fat per one-dash serving. No measured liquid density is published for a bitters this strong with no sugar; the density-classes.json 'spirit-40' class is taken as the nearest fit and marked estimated, matching the approach already used for Angostura on this site.
